custom.title: Custom rules (expressions, docs/28 §4.2)
custom.hint: Available variables (referenced with double braces): status (completed / error / cancelled), durationMs (integer milliseconds), failedCount (number of failed nodes), hasError (whether there is an error); example: {{status}} == 'error' || {{hasError}}. Expressions reuse the safe condition engine (no eval); the result must be boolean, otherwise it fails safe at runtime and raises no alert.

modal.title: Shadow run (side-channel drill)
modal.hint: Runs the latest draft of the current saved graph as a side pass: read operations execute as usual, while writes such as refunds, database writes and messages never reach their targets; it only records what the system would have done. No run record is produced and no alerts or canary gates are triggered.
modal.inputsHelp: Leave empty to use the trigger node's sample payload; for a refund webhook, for example, pass order_id.
modal.humanPlaceholder: Do not record; only inspect the system decision
modal.notePlaceholder: Optional note, recorded with the human result
